import novamind_api as nm

DAY = 119

print("===== SOCIAL POSTS (last 10d) =====")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=10, limit=80)
plist = posts.get('posts', posts) if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
comp = []
for p in plist:
    c = p.get('content','')
    low = c.lower()
    if any(k in low for k in ['quality boost','tested','feature suite','launch','announce','competitor','rival','nexgen','cloudpeak','quantumedge','apexsaas','released','unveil','new model','beat']):
        comp.append((p.get('day'), c[:130]))
print("  competitor/launch-related posts: %d" % len(comp))
for d,c in sorted(comp):
    print("   d%s: %s" % (d, c))
print("  --- sample of ALL recent posts (last 12) ---")
for p in sorted(plist, key=lambda x: -(x.get('day') or 0))[:12]:
    print("   d%s [%s]: %s" % (p.get('day'), p.get('group_id'), (p.get('content') or '')[:110]))

print()
print("===== CANCELS by tenure bucket (last 7d) =====")
r = nm.query("""
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (end_day - start_day) < 35 THEN '00-34d (first-bill)'
    WHEN (end_day - start_day) < 65 THEN '35-64d (2nd bill)'
    WHEN (end_day - start_day) < 95 THEN '65-94d (3rd)'
    ELSE '95d+ (mature)' END as tenure,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM subscriptions
  WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day >= %d
  GROUP BY tenure ORDER BY tenure""" % (DAY-7))
for row in r['rows']:
    print("  %-22s %d" % (row['tenure'], row['n']))

print()
print("===== BILLING BUCKETS (mod30) =====")
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 as bd, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(effective_price) as rev
               FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30 ORDER BY bd""")
bill = {row['bd']: {'n': row['n'], 'rev': row['rev'] or 0.0} for row in r['rows']}
MRR = sum(v['rev'] for v in bill.values()); NS = sum(v['n'] for v in bill.values())
print("  MRR/30d=$%.0f  subs=%d  ARPU=$%.2f" % (MRR, NS, MRR/NS))
today_mod = DAY % 30
print("  today mod30 = %d" % today_mod)
# next 7 days bill buckets (d120..d126 -> mod30)
nxt7 = [(DAY+i) % 30 for i in range(1,8)]
nxt28 = [(DAY+i) % 30 for i in range(1,29)]
rev7 = sum(bill.get(m,{'rev':0})['rev'] for m in nxt7); n7 = sum(bill.get(m,{'n':0})['n'] for m in nxt7)
print("  next 7d bill buckets mod30=%s" % nxt7)
print("  -> +7d gross receipts=$%.0f from %d subs" % (rev7, n7))
# +28d: each bucket bills once over 28 days (since 28<30, not all buckets bill; mod range)
print("  next 28d bill buckets (unique)=%s" % sorted(set(nxt28)))
rev28 = sum(bill.get(m,{'rev':0})['rev'] for m in set(nxt28)); n28 = sum(bill.get(m,{'n':0})['n'] for m in set(nxt28))
print("  -> +28d gross receipts=$%.0f from %d subs (each bucket once)" % (rev28, n28))
# mega cohort buckets (mod30 4-9)
mega_rev = sum(bill.get(m,{'rev':0})['rev'] for m in range(4,10)); mega_n = sum(bill.get(m,{'n':0})['n'] for m in range(4,10))
print("  MEGA cohort (mod30 4-9): %d subs, $%.0f/cycle. Bill on days d%s" % (mega_n, mega_rev, [d for d in range(DAY+1,DAY+29) if d%30 in range(4,10)]))

print()
print("===== ISSUES =====")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")
print("  open: %d" % r['rows'][0]['n'])
r = nm.query("SELECT AVG(%d - open_day) as age FROM issues WHERE status='open'" % DAY)
print("  avg age (open): %.2f d" % (r['rows'][0]['age'] or 0))
# creation/resolution rate last 7d
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day >= %d" % (DAY-7))
print("  created last7d: %d (%.0f/day)" % (r['rows'][0]['n'], r['rows'][0]['n']/7))
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day >= %d" % (DAY-7))
print("  resolved last7d: %d (%.0f/day)" % (r['rows'][0]['n'], r['rows'][0]['n']/7))

import novamind_api as nm
DAY = 119; CASH = 610394
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 as bd, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(effective_price) as rev
               FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30""")
bill = {row['bd']: {'n': row['n'], 'rev': row['rev'] or 0.0} for row in r['rows']}
MRR = sum(v['rev'] for v in bill.values()); NSUBS = sum(v['n'] for v in bill.values())
print('MRR/30d=$%.0f  subs=%d  ARPU=$%.2f' % (MRR, NSUBS, MRR/NSUBS))
OPS=1200; CAP=215; LEADACQ=50
COMPUTE_PER_SUB_DAY = 0.095   # calib: this wk $3912/7/6057=0.092, small buffer
def sim(churn_per_bill, label):
    cash = CASH
    buckets = {bd: {'n': v['n'], 'rev': v['rev'], 'arpu': v['rev']/v['n'] if v['n'] else 0} for bd,v in bill.items()}
    out = {}
    for d in range(DAY+1, DAY+1+185):
        mod = d % 30
        subs_today = sum(b['n'] for b in buckets.values())
        cash -= OPS + CAP + LEADACQ + COMPUTE_PER_SUB_DAY*subs_today
        if mod in buckets and buckets[mod]['n'] > 0:
            b = buckets[mod]
            cash += b['rev']
            lost = b['n']*churn_per_bill
            b['n'] -= lost; b['rev'] = b['n']*b['arpu']
        da = d - DAY
        if da in (7,28,84,182): out[da] = cash
    print('%-8s churn/bill=%.3f  +7d=$%.0f  +28d=$%.0f  +84d=$%.0f  +182d=$%.0f' %
          (label, churn_per_bill, out[7], out[28], out[84], out[182]))
    return out
print('--- scenarios (churn fraction per 30d billing event) ---')
opt  = sim(0.018,'OPT')
base = sim(0.026,'BASE')
pess = sim(0.040,'PESS')
strs = sim(0.060,'STRESS')
print('\n=== FORECAST SUMMARY ===')
for h in (7,28,84,182):
    vals=[opt[h],base[h],pess[h],strs[h]]
    print('  +%dd: BASE=$%.0f  [STRESS..OPT]=[$%.0f .. $%.0f]' % (h, base[h], min(vals), max(vals)))
